{{Quote|I'm Captain Theraguin&mdash;last officer on the job here since the patrols stopped.|Captain Theraguin|<ref name="SWTORboom" />}}
'''Theraguin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] living on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Theraguin served with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] (CSF) and had attained the [[Police rank|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. By [[3643 BBY]], Therguin was working in the [[Black Sun territory]]. Although most CSF forces had abandoned the area, Theraguin continued to do his best to serve the locals who were oppressed and abused by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The locals only venture out of their apartments when they have to scrounge for supplies. Now with no security forces, what future do they have?|Theraguin, discussing conditions in the Black Sun Territory|<ref name="SWTORboom" />}}
Theraguin was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] (CSF). He achieved the [[Police rank|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]], and during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Theraguin worked in the [[Black Sun territory]] of Coruscant.<ref name="SWTORboom" /> After the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], the CSF struggled to [[Coruscant riots (3653 BBY)|maintain order]] and eventually called for [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] support. However, large areas of the planet were lost to gangs who consolidated into the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate. Claiming sectors as their own, mostly in Coruscant's lower levels, Black Sun sought to impose its own order. The CSF, having sustained casualties both during the Sacking and the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after, all but abandoned the area as they drew back to [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] vital government and commerce districts.<ref name="SWTORcsfcodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Coruscant Security}}</ref> Theraguin was one of the few [[Officer/Legends|officers]] who stayed behind to help as best as he could, although CSF could do little more than build blockades and keep the street battles contained to certain areas.<ref name="SWTORboom" />

Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="SWTORdate">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Black Sun developed a new way of terrorizing the locals and [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]]. Its members stole crates of Republic supplies and then placed them in public areas, but not before rigging them with [[Bomb/Legends|explosives]]. When refugees went to open them, the crates exploded and [[Death/Legends|killed]] all in the immediate area. Theraguin did not originally believe the stories about the "game" until he witnessed a woman blown to pieces by one of the explosive crates. He tried to defuse the crates, but there was little he could do without being killed himself by Black Sun [[Scoundrel/Legends|thugs]].<ref name="SWTORboom" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
At that [[Time/Legends|time]] a Republic individual offered to defuse the explosives. Theraguin accepted the offer, and the individual proceeded to disarm the rigged crates, in the process also killing the Black Sun thugs who were behind the terror. Theraguin offered the individual a reward upon return, but was refused. He was pleasantly surprised to find someone not out to make a profit. Theraguin was thankful for the individual's assistance and continued his work in the Black Sun Territory.<ref name="SWTORboom" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|My commander gave up on this sector a long time ago. I shouldn't even be here.|Theraguin, discussing the Black Sun Territory|<ref name="SWTORboom" />}}
Theraguin was a large, older man with [[Color/Legends|dark]] skin, brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and graying [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. A veteran police officer, Theraguin was one of the few, if not the only, cop who continued to work in the Black Sun Territory, which most officers, including his [[Unidentified Coruscant Security commander|superior]], had abandoned. Determined to do what he could to relieve the suffering of the locals, Theraguin defied Black Sun's thugs and went beyond the CSF's barricades into the territory. He went so far as to risk his life to defuse explosives if it would save lives. However, the violence and hopelessness of the Black Sun Territory left Theraguin frustrated. He sarcastically referred to himself as the "last officer on the job" in that sector.<ref name="SWTORboom" />

As with many of his fellow veteran cops, Theraguin had joined the CSF to keep the peace. The years after the Sacking of Coruscant, however, brought with them a brutal urban warfare&mdash;something for which Theraguin and the CSF were not trained.<ref name="SWTORcsfcodex" /> While he knew his limitations, Theraguin continued to work in the Black Sun Territory despite all the difficulties.<ref name="SWTORboom" />

==Behind the scenes==
Theraguin appears in the "Boom" Republic-sided Coruscant mission in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] by [[BioWare]] released on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The player can choose to accept the mission or not. Upon completion of the mission, the player can choose to not accept the reward for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] points.
